## {.workflow-agent}

```{=html}
<div class="slide s4">
  <div class="sys-label">SYS_04 / CONTROL FLOW</div>
  <div class="s4-title">WORKFLOW <span>≠</span> AGENT</div>
  <div class="workflow-side">
    <div class="control-name">WORKFLOW</div>
    <div class="control-flow">TRIGGER <b>→</b> DATA <b>→</b> AI <b>→</b> RULE <b>→</b> ACTION</div>
    <div class="control-label">PREDEFINED CONTROL</div>
  </div>
  <div class="agent-side fragment">
    <div class="control-name">AGENT</div>
    <div class="agent-goal">GOAL</div>
    <div class="agent-loop"><span>OBSERVE</span><b>→</b><span>DECIDE</span><b>→</b><span class="active">ACT</span><b class="loopback">↺</b></div>
    <div class="control-label">DYNAMIC CONTROL</div>
  </div>
  <div class="s4-synthesis fragment"><div>A WORKFLOW CONTAINS AI.</div><div class="active">AN AGENT CONTAINS A WORKFLOW.</div></div>
  <div class="s4-caution fragment">USEFUL TAXONOMY — NOT A UNIVERSAL DEFINITION</div>
  <div class="source"><span>TECHNICAL BASIS</span> [3] Anthropic (2024), “Building effective agents.” Containment wording is our synthesis.</div>
</div>
```

## {.human-boundary}

```{=html}
<div class="slide s8">
  <div class="sys-label">SYS_08 / HUMAN BOUNDARY</div>
  <div class="s8-title">DON’T REMOVE THE HUMAN.<br><span>MOVE THEM.</span></div>
  <div class="takeover-flow">
    <div class="flow-step agent-step">AGENT<br>WORKS</div><div class="flow-arrow fragment" data-fragment-index="0">→</div>
    <div class="flow-step gate-step fragment" data-fragment-index="0">LOGIN<br>/ 2FA</div><div class="flow-arrow fragment" data-fragment-index="1">→</div>
    <div class="flow-step human-step fragment" data-fragment-index="1">HUMAN<br>TAKES CONTROL</div><div class="flow-arrow fragment" data-fragment-index="2">→</div>
    <div class="flow-step fragment" data-fragment-index="2">HAND<br>BACK</div><div class="flow-arrow fragment" data-fragment-index="3">→</div>
    <div class="flow-step agent-step fragment" data-fragment-index="3">AGENT<br>RESUMES</div>
  </div>
  <div class="s8-example fragment">You can let AI work — and take over only when a step needs you.<br><span>Hermes is one current example.</span></div>
  <div class="s8-caution fragment">TOOL-LEVEL FENCE · NOT AN OS-LEVEL SECURITY BOUNDARY</div>
  <div class="source"><span>SOURCE</span> [7] Nous Research, Hermes Agent documentation: “Bot Screen.”</div>
</div>
```
